This site has two parts: a personal introduction (CV, experience) and a **knowledge base** collecting what I learn, both course by course in my Master's program and through my own self-study.

### Areas of interest

- **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central / Navision** — ERP development, customization, integrations
